(C. & S.B.) Office Notes

Sir,

Arthur Warren Burgess, British, arrived in Shanghai
from London on November 28, 1928 as the travelling
representative of Messrs W.A. Tyzack & Co. Stella Works,
Sheffield. From the date of his arrival until January 1,
1929 he resided with his wife at the Crystal Hotel,
Seward Road, and on that date removed to a licenced
boarding house No. 198 Range Road, which premises Burgess
bought for the sum of $2,800.

He and his wife resided there and conducted a boarding
house business until July 1, 1929 when they gave up the
premises as they found they could not make it pay.
Burgess then removed to his present address, No. 177
Route Mayen.

It is not known that he has actually dealt in firearms
and he is regarded by those engaged in this trade as
being a person who talks rather that acts. He is said
to have served with the Indian Army during the Great War,
and when demobilised, obtained his position with the
Stella Works, Sheffield.

On January 23, 1929 Burgess applied for and obtained
a licence to keep a pistol in his house at No. 198 Range
Road.

W. Ounnean.
D. S. I.

（刑事与特别处）办公笔记

先生：

亚瑟·沃伦·伯吉斯（Arthur Warren Burgess），英籍，于 1928 年 11 月 28 日从伦敦抵达上海，身份为谢菲尔德斯特拉工厂（Stella Works, Sheffield）W.A. Tyzack 公司的旅行代表。自抵达之日起至 1929 年 1 月 1 日，他与妻子居住在西华德路（Seward Road）的水晶饭店（Crystal Hotel），并于该日迁至兰路（Range Road）198 号的一家持牌寄宿舍，伯吉斯以 2,800 元的价格购买了该处房产。

他与妻子在此居住并经营寄宿舍业务，直至 1929 年 7 月 1 日，因发现无利可图而放弃该处房产。随后，伯吉斯迁至其现址，迈恩路（Route Mayen）177 号。

目前并无证据表明他实际从事过枪支交易，从事该行业的人士认为他是一个多说少做之人。据说他在大战期间曾在印度军队服役，复员后获得了在谢菲尔德斯特拉工厂的职位。

1929 年 1 月 23 日，伯吉斯申请并获准在其位于兰路 198 号的住所内持有手枪。

W. Ounnean.
副督察长。

侦探长。
